_comment: Standalone test-only model for auth/validate-expectations.sh's own fixtures — not a real store. `national_calendar` deliberately has NO relations block at all, exactly as if one had been deleted wholesale from a real model; `diocesan_calendar` keeps admin/editor/viewer. A consumer whose required_relations uses the "*" wildcard must see national_calendar as in scope (it is in required_types) and report one violation per missing relation, rather than silently skipping the relation-less type — the more destructive edit must not be the one that passes.
